Package org.example.dao

Class DatabaseManager<T>

java.lang.Object
org.example.dao.DatabaseManager<T>
Type Parameters:
T - tipul modelului, trebuie sa corespunda cu numele tabelei din baza de date
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientDAO, OrderDAO, ProductDAO
public sealed class DatabaseManager<T> extends Object permits ClientDAO, ProductDAO, OrderDAO
Clasa generica DAO cu operatii CRUD pentru orice model, construite dinamic prin reflectie.
Author:
Bianca Herghelegiu
